independence_premises.unconditional: No additional consistency or soundness premise.
independence_premises.zfc_arithmetic_soundness: Every closed first-order arithmetic sentence whose standard translation is provable in ZFC is true in standard N.

lean.independence_note: An expert metatheory review must fix each exact ZFC sentence, proof relation and permitted premise. Arithmetic soundness uses truth in standard N, not truth in an arbitrary model.

tasks.prompt: Resolve whether AM is contained in ACC⁰ under the attached exact class conventions. Independence may be unconditional or conditional on Con(ZFC) or arithmetic soundness of ZFC, with both unprovability directions under the same stated premise. Arithmetic soundness means all first-order arithmetic sentences whose standard translations ZFC proves are true in standard N. Retain the premise explicitly; stronger unproved assumptions are not permitted. Identify every additional ordered-pair consequence your proof establishes. Return proof artifacts and exact claim objects; the evaluator, not the model, decides verification and points.
